description: Advanced administrative interface for configuring entity field visibility, ordering, and permissions. Allows customization of how data is displayed in lists and forms across different entities (Partners, Contacts, Interactions).

pages.name: EntityManagerComponent
pages.description: This administrative page provides a powerful interface for customizing how data fields are presented across various entities like Partners, Contacts, and Interactions. Users can control field visibility, reorder columns, and manage permissions to ensure data is displayed optimally and securely.

help_guidance.when_stuck: If you're unsure how to proceed, first select an entity (e.g., 'Partners' or 'Contacts') from the dropdown menu. Once an entity is selected, you can use the available tabs (e.g., Field Configuration, Field Ordering, Permissions) to customize its fields. Remember that changes are typically auto-saved as you make them, so you can see the effects immediately by navigating to the respective entity's list view.
common_tasks: Configuring field visibility: Select the desired entity, navigate to the 'Field Configuration' tab, and then use the checkboxes to show or hide specific columns.
Reordering columns: After selecting an entity, go to the 'Field Ordering' tab. You can then drag and drop fields to arrange them in your preferred display order.
Managing permissions: To control who can view or edit specific fields, select the entity, go to the 'Permissions' tab, and adjust the access settings for each field.
Customizing display: Use the 'Display Settings' section (if available) to configure labels, icons, or other visual aspects of the fields.
Testing changes: After making modifications, navigate to the list view or detail page of the entity you configured to verify that your changes have been applied correctly.
help_guidance.getting_started: To begin, select an entity from the dropdown at the top of the page. This will load the configuration options for that specific entity. You can then use the tabs to manage field visibility, order, and permissions. Start with 'Field Configuration' to decide which columns are visible in lists and forms.
